title: AdapSNE: Adaptive Fireworks-Optimized and Entropy-Guided Dataset Sampling for Edge DNN Training

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by evaluating the downstream Top-1 training accuracy of models trained on the compressed datasets and utilizing grid-based entropy to quantify the uniformity and distribution quality of the sampled data points (exemplars).

Evaluated by applying datasets compressed via one specific neural network backbone (e.g., ResNet-18) to train completely different network architectures (e.g., ViT, CNext) and measuring the resulting drop in generalization accuracy.
